items.title: Delivering contextual job matching for millions with OpenAI
items.summary: Indeed, whose mission is to help people get jobs, is the world’s #1 job site. Over 350 million unique visitors come to Indeed every month to connect with more than 3.5 million employers and over 32 million jobs. But what’s more is that every three seconds someone gets hired on Indeed.
items.summaryZh: 利用 OpenAI 为数百万人提供情境职位匹配。Indeed 的使命是帮助人们找到工作，是世界排名第一的求职网站。每月有超过 3.5 亿的独立访客访问 Indeed，与超过 350 万雇主和超过 3200 万个工作岗位建立联系。
